name: Embracing Darkness
source:
"Embracing Darkness" is a fan project in which players can enjoy a short encounter with Local Villains Tiefedorf and Shuraomaru.

[From [url=https://deadlyweiss.itch.io/embracingdarkness-en]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Embracing Darkness》是一部同人作品，让玩家与地方特摄反派角色蒂费多尔夫、修罗王丸来一场短暂的邂逅。

[摘自[url=https://deadlyweiss.itch.io/embracingdarkness-en]Itch.io[/url]]
